name: JG_FSCL_DOC_HDRS_ALL
description: This table contains transaction header level attributes required for generating fiscal document. Product teams would populate this table with their transaction header attributes prior to calling the fiscal document generation process.

columns.name: DOC_HDR_ID
columns.description: Carrier or party site identifier that provided freight services for shipment.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a functional area within a software suite of products. For example: Financials, or Payroll.

columns.name: ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Entity code of the transaction, which indicates the type of transaction being created.

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Application event class of the transaction, such as requisition, purchase order and agreement, and release.

columns.name: TRX_ID
columns.description: System-generated identification number of a transaction.

columns.name: TRX_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the transaction occurred.

columns.name: TRX_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: The three-letter ISO (International Organization for Standardization) code associated with a currency of the transaction.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CONVERSION_DATE
columns.description: The date as of which a conversion rate is used to convert an amount into another currency.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CONVERSION_RATE
columns.description: Exchange rate at which the principal unit of one currency can be converted into another currency.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CONVERSION_TYPE
columns.description: Source of a currency conversion rate, such as user defined, spot, or corporate.

columns.name: TRX_FD_TYPE_DETERMINANT
columns.description: Fiscal document type determinant, which indicates if single or multiple fiscal documents are required for a transaction.

columns.name: PO_NUMBER
columns.description: Number of a commercial document that is used to request a seller to supply a product or service in return for payment.

columns.name: FREIGHT_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Carrier or party who provided freight service for the shipment.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: EVENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Application event type for the transaction.

columns.name: TRX_LEVEL_TYPE
columns.description: Column to record the level at which the transaction line identifier is stored. Possible values are LINE, SHIPMENT and FREIGHT.

columns.name: HDR_TRX_USER_KEY1
columns.description: First component of the user composite key to uniquely identify the transaction.

columns.name: HDR_TRX_USER_KEY2
columns.description: Second component of the user composite key to uniquely identify the transaction.

columns.name: HDR_TRX_USER_KEY3
columns.description: Third component of the user composite key to uniquely identify the transaction.

columns.name: HDR_TRX_USER_KEY4
columns.description: Fourth component of the user composite key to uniquely identify the transaction.

columns.name: HDR_TRX_USER_KEY5
columns.description: Fifth component of the user composite key to uniquely identify the transaction.

columns.name: HDR_TRX_USER_KEY6
columns.description: Sixth component of the user composite key to uniquely identify the transaction.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger identifier for the self-contained accounting information set for single or multiple legal or management entities.

columns.name: MINIMUM_ACCOUNTABLE_UNIT
columns.description: Minimum accountable unit of the entered currency.

columns.name: PRECISION
columns.description: Precision of the transaction currency.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Legal entity identifier for the transaction.

columns.name: ESTABLISHMENT_ID
columns.description: Establishment identifier of the first party associated with the transaction.

columns.name: DEFAULT_TAXATION_COUNTRY
columns.description: Country where the transaction is deemed to have taken place for taxation purposes.

columns.name: TRX_NUMBER
columns.description: Numeric identifier of a transaction.

columns.name: TRX_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the transaction.

columns.name: TRX_COMMUNICATED_DATE
columns.description: Printed or Received date of the transaction.

columns.name: TRX_DUE_DATE
columns.description: Payment due date of the transaction.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_SUB_TYPE
columns.description: Set up document fiscal classifications to classify transactions that require special documentation to accompany the transaction, as designated by the tax authority.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_TAX_INVOICE_NUMBER
columns.description: Transaction number on the supplier tax invoice.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_TAX_INVOICE_DATE
columns.description: Transaction date on the supplier tax invoice.

columns.name: TAX_INVOICE_DATE
columns.description: Transaction date for tax invoice generated by Receivables.

columns.name: TAX_INVOICE_NUMBER
columns.description: Number for tax invoice generated by Receivables.

columns.name: RELATED_DOC_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Related document application identifier.

columns.name: RELATED_DOC_ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Transaction type of the related document.

columns.name: RELATED_DOC_EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Related document event class code.

columns.name: RELATED_DOC_TRX_ID
columns.description: Primary transaction identifier of the related document.

columns.name: REL_DOC_HDR_TRX_USER_KEY1
columns.description: First component of the user composite key for uniquely identifying the related document.

columns.name: REL_DOC_HDR_TRX_USER_KEY2
columns.description: Second component of the user composite key for uniquely identifying the related document.

columns.name: REL_DOC_HDR_TRX_USER_KEY3
columns.description: Third component of the user composite key for uniquely identifying the related document.

columns.name: REL_DOC_HDR_TRX_USER_KEY4
columns.description: Fourth component of the user composite key for uniquely identifying the related document.

columns.name: REL_DOC_HDR_TRX_USER_KEY5
columns.description: Fifth component of the user composite key for the uniquely identifying related document.

columns.name: REL_DOC_HDR_TRX_USER_KEY6
columns.description: Sixth component of the user composite key for the uniquely identifying related document.

columns.name: RELATED_DOC_NUMBER
columns.description: Transaction number of the related document.

columns.name: RELATED_DOC_DATE
columns.description: Document date of the related transaction.

columns.name: HDR_GL_DATE
columns.description: Transaction header level accounting date.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
